## Got Questions?

Flim is a strong ShotDeck alternative for creative professionals who need more than a filter-based archive. Where ShotDeck organises stills by technical metadata and focuses heavily on Hollywood cinema. Flim's AI Search understands natural language descriptions: mood, colour, era, feeling. The library extends beyond cinema to include ads, music videos, fashion films, TV series, and documentaries, with over 2 million frames. And uniquely, Flim covers the full creative workflow: collaborative boards, Magic Board (instant board from a pitch), Aesthetics to lock a visual style, and a cinematic generation studio, Nano Banana for images, Veo and Seedance for video, that generates within it. [...] Flim's library contains over 2 million frames and clips drawn from films, series, ads, music videos, fashion films, and documentaries, with broader geographic and historical diversity than ShotDeck, which skews heavily toward US productions. For creatives working across advertising, fashion, and music video, Flim's coverage is more aligned with real project needs.

Flim offers a free tier with unlimited search and one download per day, so you can explore the library and test AI Search before committing to a plan. Paid plans start at €14.90 per month. See the full breakdown at flim.ai/pricing. [...] Flim's library was built with broader ambitions. Over 2 million frames and video extracts drawn from films, TV series, ads, music videos, fashion films, and documentaries, with genuine geographic and historical range. For a commercial director pitching a car campaign, that means richer access to advertising references alongside cinema. For a music video director, it means a library with broader international range and deeper niche coverage; ShotDeck covers music videos and ads too, but skews heavily US and mainstream.
